digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and datetime timezone handling
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families are not currently enabled in the global configuration; they must be added to pyproject.toml after all existing violations are remediated.

Three DTZ violations exist in production code: datetime.fromtimestamp() and datetime.strptime() in validate_checks.py lack explicit timezone arguments; date.today() in security_pin.py is not timezone-aware.

Timestamp clustering in validate_checks.py must use explicit datetime.timezone.utc for both integer epoch seconds and timezone-less persisted strings to ensure UTC semantics independent of process TZ.
Security-pin cadence determination must remain host-local calendar-date logic by obtaining an aware instant with explicit tz parameter, converting to host timezone, then extracting the date.

A dedicated test module test_ruff_ratchet.py must verify ASYNC/DTZ selection, prohibit datetime.UTC usage, confirm absence of S selector and Semgrep configuration, and prove timezone invariance across at least two TZ environment values on POSIX/macOS platforms.
